description: This file defines a RecyclerView.Adapter called DirectoryEntryAdapter for displaying directory entries within an Android application. It includes a nested ViewHolder class for caching views and binds directory entry data to item views, showing file names, mime types, and icons based on whether the entry is a directory or a file.

classes.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for binding directory entries to views in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder that caches references to views for a directory entry item.

methods.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a list of directory entries.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new ViewHolder objects by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds directory entry data to the views in the ViewHolder for a given position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of directory entries.
